name: Preacher
description: A preacher sets out on a mission to make the almighty himself confess his sin of abandoning the world. With his best friend Cassidy, an alcoholic Irish vampire, his love Tulip, a red blooded gun towing Texan, and the power of genesis, an unholy child born from an angel and a devil, Jesse gives up everything to set the world straight with its creator.

videos.title: A Look at the Series
videos.overview: Behind the scenes with the cast and crew to find out what to expect from the Preacher series.

videos.title: Talking Preacher on Pilot
videos.overview: Series star Dominic Cooper and executive producers Seth Rogen, Evan Goldberg and Sam Catlin join host Chris Hardwick to discuss the series premiere of Preacher.

videos.overview: "Pilot" and "See". An in-depth look at the two sides of Jesse Custer as he attempts to escape his past and begins to discover his powers.

videos.title: Chapters 3 and 4 Bonus Edition
videos.overview: "The Possibilities" and "Monster Swamp". An inside look at Cassidy's attempt to fend off the angels. Jesse and Tulip and Jesse's further exploration of his newfound powers.

videos.title: Chapter 5 Bonus Edition
videos.overview: "South Will Rise Again." Jesse becomes Anville's latest rock star; plus an in-depth look at Tulip and Cassidy's budding relationship.

videos.title: Talking Preacher on Call and Response
videos.overview: Actor Ian Coletti (Eugene "Arseface" Root), and executive producers Seth Rogen and Sam Catlin join host Chris Hardwick to discuss the season 1 finale of Preacher.

videos.overview: Dominic Cooper, Graham McTavish, and Sam Catlin discuss the latest episodes of Preacher. Hosted by Chris Hardwick.

videos.title: Talking Preacher on The End of the Road
videos.overview: Dominic Cooper, Pip Torrens, Ian Colletti and Sam Catlin discuss the latest episode of Preacher. Host Chris Hardwick.

videos.overview: A collection of the deleted and extended scenes from all episodes except 6 and 9 of Season 1 of Preacher.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: Jesse struggles to escape a past that is slowly catching up to him. A mysterious entity comes to earth, leaving a wave of destruction in its wake.

videos.title: See
videos.overview: Jesse tries to be a "good preacher," unaware that a mysterious duo is after him. Meanwhile, the enigmatic Cowboy is introduced.

videos.title: The Possibilities
videos.overview: Jesse explores his newfound power with Cassidy's help. Meanwhile, armed with new information, Tulip tries to convince Jesse to set out for revenge.

videos.title: Monster Swamp
videos.overview: Jesse makes Quincannon a bet he can't refuse; and Cassidy works to fend off the angels. Meanwhile, Tulip tries to bring justice to Annville.

videos.title: South Will Rise Again
videos.overview: After his stunt with Quincannon, Jesse is Annville's newest rock star; and Tulip and Cassidy connect. Meanwhile, the Cowboy makes a tragic decision.

videos.title: Sundowner
videos.overview: Jesse finally comes face to face with Deblanc and Fiore and learns about the mysterious entity that has taken over his body.

videos.title: He Gone
videos.overview: Jesse's actions alienate and endanger those closest to him as we glimpse into his past and finally learn the root of all of his guilt.

videos.title: El Valero
videos.overview: Jesse protects his church in a vicious gun battle against Quincannon and the Meat Men; Tulip hopes to save a friend.

videos.title: Finish the Song
videos.overview: Jesse is on the run while those around him face life-altering decisions. The Cowboy returns to Ratwater to exact his revenge.

videos.title: Call and Response
videos.overview: It is the day the entire town has been waiting for, as Jesse tries to follow through on his promise to get answers from Heaven.

videos.title: On the Road
videos.overview: Jesse, Tulip, and Cassidy begin the search to find God. The trio realize they are being followed by a killer cowboy from Hell.

videos.title: Mumbai Sky Tower
videos.overview: Jesse, Tulip, and Cassidy track a lead from Heaven. The trio tries to find out who the Cowboy is and why he's attempting to kill them.

videos.title: Damsels
videos.overview: Jesse, Tulip, and Cassidy get a tip that God may be in New Orleans. Tulip is hiding a secret and their stop in New Orleans risks exposing her.

videos.title: Viktor
videos.overview: Jesse pursues a lead and dives deeper into his search for God with Cassidy and we discover more about Tulip's secret past.

videos.title: Dallas
videos.overview: After learning about Tulip's secret relationship, we revisit Jesse and Tulip's rocky past and see a darker side of Jesse.

videos.title: Sokosha
videos.overview: The Saint corners the trio. Jesse makes a deal with the killer Cowboy. Jesse races to save Tulip and Cassidy.

videos.title: Pig
videos.overview: Tulip confronts her near-death experience. Denis asks Cassidy for a favor. Jesse questions the price of saving Cassidy and Tulip.

videos.title: Holes
videos.overview: Jesse investigates a fresh clue about God. Tulip makes friends with a new neighbor, and we get a glimpse into Cassidy's past relationship with Denis.

videos.title: Puzzle Piece
videos.overview: Jesse gets a much-needed breakthrough on his search for God. Tulip continues to spiral and Cassidy makes a life-altering decision for Denis.

videos.title: Dirty Little Secret
videos.overview: Jesse connects with an unlikely source and learns more about God's whereabouts. Tulip can't forgive Jesse when she finds out he's been lying to her.

videos.title: Backdoors
videos.overview: The mission begins to alienate Tulip and Cassidy. Tulip receives advice about her relationship with Jesse. Cassidy begins to doubt Denis.

videos.title: On Your Knees
videos.overview: Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy hit a bump in the road and decide to leave New Orleans. An old foe resurfaces and causes a change of plans.

videos.title: The End of the Road
videos.overview: Jesse questions the path ahead. Tulip uncovers a dangerous secret. Cassidy struggles with a difficult truth.

videos.title: Angelville
videos.overview: In an effort to save Tulip, Jesse and Cassidy take her to Jesse's family home, Angelville. Jesse reunites with the people he fears most: his family.

videos.title: Sonsabitches
videos.overview: Desperate to escape Angelville and his family, Jesse attempts to forge an unlikely alliance with a familiar adversary.

videos.title: Gonna Hurt
videos.overview: While Jesse works to pay back his debt to Gran'ma, Tulip and Cassidy risk their safety as they make their own plans to get out of Angelville.

videos.title: The Tombs
videos.overview: As Jesse helps reinvigorate business at Angelville, he tests Tulip and Cassidy's faith in him when Angelville brings out a darker side of him.

videos.title: The Coffin
videos.overview: As Cassidy falls in with a group of mysterious strangers in New Orleans, Tulip and Jesse deal with the fallout of a failed escape from Angelville.

videos.title: Les Enfants du Sang
videos.overview: Tulip, Jesse, Jody and T.C. hatch an ambitious plan to save both Gran'ma's and Tulip's lives; Cassidy explores a new friendship in New Orleans.

videos.title: Hilter
videos.overview: Jesse, Tulip, Gran'ma and Starr form an uneasy partnership to avert the apocalypse; Cassidy learns to love Eccarius, but at a cost.

videos.title: The Tom/Brady
videos.overview: Annville, Angelville and the Grail team up to steal souls in New Orleans and Osaka in a last-ditch effort to satisfy Gran'ma and save the world.

videos.title: Schwanzkopf
videos.overview: Divided and trapped, Tulip, Jesse and Cassidy battle old friends, new enemies and loved ones to escape certain death - or worse.

videos.title: The Light Above
videos.overview: Jesse returns home for what he hopes is the last time but angers Starr and endangers Cassidy in the process; Tulip battles hell and Nazis.

videos.title: Masada
videos.overview: Jesse is rocked by visions of an apocalyptic future as he and Tulip prepare for an all-out assault on Masada, where Cassidy – trapped to a torturous fate – struggles to hang on. But Starr and his Grail operatives are ready for them…

videos.title: Last Supper
videos.overview: God maneuvers the chess pieces of His apocalypse closer to the endgame as Jesse takes off in search of a mysterious rock formation that may be the final leg of his journey. Meanwhile, Tulip devises one last-ditch effort to try and save Cassidy from his endless torture.

videos.title: Deviant
videos.overview: Tulip gets in too deep in Masada; Cassidy reflects on a lost life; the Saint closes in on Jesse.

videos.title: Search and Rescue
videos.overview: Tulip forges an unexpected alliance to save Cassidy; Jesse finds himself stranded.

videos.title: Bleak City
videos.overview: Tulip reunites with Cassidy and Eugene finds Jesse; the Grail's agenda threatens to unwind.

videos.title: The Lost Apostle
videos.overview: Tulip and Cass track Jesse and the Saint of Killers, while Starr searches for the missing messiah.

videos.title: Messiahs
videos.overview: Tulip and Cass tear after God; an old friend presents Jesse with an unique opportunity.

videos.title: Fear of the Lord
videos.overview: Tulip and Cass struggle to keep Humperdoo hidden from the Grail, while Jesse remains MIA.

videos.title: Overture
videos.overview: Jesse, Tulip and Cassidy mount one final assault on Masada as the Apocalypse Revue begins.

videos.title: End of the World
videos.overview: The curtain falls on the Apocalypse Revue as the fate of the world is decided, and the long journey of a preacher and his friends comes to an end.
